claims.disproof_condition: 條件：金像電下一份年報的重要契約不再列這筆或寫解約、縮減。核查頻率：每年（年報）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim。
claims.statement: Customer-side capex for drilling (Gold Circuit Electronics annual report FY2025): it has volume capability for 52-layer boards, is developing back-drill residual-copper control, and lists a purchase contract with Tongtai Machine & Tool (東台精機) running 2025-05-26 to 2028-12-31 for 21 five-axis drilling machines and 6 six-axis CCD drilling machines.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Prismark 實績或板廠一手寫出 18 層以上高階多層板成長遠低於此。核查頻率：每半年（板廠年報與法說轉引）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim。
claims.statement: Industry data relayed by Gold Circuit Electronics (citing Prismark): multilayer boards were the fastest-growing PCB segment in 2025, with boards of 18 layers and above growing about 72.8% in value.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：金像電下一份年報的原料段寫出某項原料缺貨或交期延長。核查頻率：每年（年報）＋每季（法說）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀做板層與相關材料層讀圖。
claims.statement: Gold Circuit Electronics lists its main raw materials as substrates (laminates), prepreg, copper foil, dry film and plating chemicals, bought from major domestic suppliers with long-term stable supply relationships; drill bits are not listed among its main raw materials.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：金像電下一份年報的重要契約或重訊寫出這兩份電鍍線契約解約、縮減，或寫明電鍍線只向單一設備商採購。核查頻率：每年（年報重要契約，約 5 月）＋每月（MOPS 重訊）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim，重讀電鍍設備層讀圖的 neither 出口。
claims.statement: Customer-side fact (Gold Circuit Electronics FY2025 annual report, important contracts, p.99): Gold Circuit holds purchase contracts for a first-copper pulse automatic plating line from Kunshan Jingming Machinery (114/6/21-117/12/31 ROC, i.e. 2025-06-21 to 2028-12-31) and a gantry-type pulse plating line from Tongtai Machine & Tool (114/12/10-117/12/31 ROC, i.e. 2025-12-10 to 2028-12-31); both list no restrictive terms. One PCB maker buys plating lines from at least two vendors. The two lines are different types (first-copper vs gantry), so this shows more than one vendor at the layer, not that the same line type was switched.
